target.title: fix #100368: mark undelivered message_tool_only finals in replay
target.body:
## Summary

- Problem: `message_tool_only` can withhold a substantive final assistant reply from the source lane while later session context still treats that text like a normal assistant turn.
- Solution: append a hidden custom transcript notice for substantive undelivered `message_tool_only` finals and keep that notice attached during transcript replay.
- What changed: one shared notice definition, one runtime write path in `runReplyAgent`, and transcript replay preservation for that exact notice type.
- What was not changed: retry recovery, `pendingFinalDelivery`, source reply dispatch, message tool delivery, provider behavior, and ordinary assistant transcript entries.
- Fixes #100368.

## What Problem This Solves

Issue #100368 reports a session-state mismatch: the source lane does not show an ordinary final assistant reply in `message_tool_only` mode unless it was sent through the message tool, but follow-up agent context can still see that ordinary assistant final as if it were user-visible conversation history. The result is phantom history: the agent can reason from text the user never saw or approved.

This patch makes the delivery state explicit at the transcript/context boundary. When the runtime has the real delivery facts available, it records a hidden custom notice saying the preceding assistant final was not delivered to the user.

## User Impact

Users running `message_tool_only` lanes get follow-up context that reflects delivery reality. A later agent run can distinguish private/undelivered assistant text from source-channel-visible conversation, which reduces the chance of acting on a false assumption that the user saw or accepted the withheld final.

## Origin / follow-up

Fixes #100368.

The issue evidence identifies the current-main path: `message_tool_only` suppresses substantive ordinary finals, while session persistence/context replay lacks an undelivered marker. This PR implements the narrow replay-visible marker option only.

## Competition / linked PR analysis

- **Linked PR(s):** none for this fix path. Related open PR scan reviewed #101064 after daily-fix surfaced it through broad public-contract matching.
- **Gap in linked PR(s):** #101064 is about compaction doctor warnings and does not touch `auto-reply/reply`, `message_tool_only`, session transcript persistence, or transcript replay.
- **Why this patch is better/canonical:** this patch changes the runtime location that already knows the source reply delivery mode, send policy, successful source delivery state, final text, session key, session file, and replay boundary. It does not move the fix into a downstream display-only projection.
- **Local real behavior proof advantage:** the proof exercises real temporary session store files, JSONL transcript files, `persistSessionTranscriptTurn`, `SessionManager.open(...).buildSessionContext()`, and transcript replay file I/O.

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** `message_tool_only` finals that are withheld from the source lane now get a replay/context-visible undelivered notice, so follow-up context no longer treats the preceding assistant final as ordinary user-visible conversation without a delivery warning.
- **Canonical reachability path:** user config / channel route selects `sourceReplyDeliveryMode: "message_tool_only"` -> typed auto-reply options reach `runReplyAgent` -> runtime source reply policy suppresses ordinary delivery when the message tool did not send successfully -> the runtime writes the hidden custom notice through `persistSessionTranscriptTurn` -> session context reads it through `SessionManager.open(...).buildSessionContext()` -> transcript replay keeps the notice when rotating the recent user/assistant tail.
- **Boundary crossed:** the verification crosses OpenClaw's runtime session-state boundary from reply execution into real session store and JSONL transcript files, then crosses the model-consumed session context builder boundary and the transcript replay file-copy boundary.
- **Shared helper / provider constraint check:** this is not a provider constraint change. The patch reuses existing repository helpers: `persistSessionTranscriptTurn` for transcript writes, `SessionManager.open(...).buildSessionContext()` for context proof, `replayRecentUserAssistantMessages()` for rotation replay, and `isSilentReplyText` for the existing silent-reply invariant.
- **Real environment tested:** local OpenClaw worktree with real temp session store files, real JSONL transcript files, production session persistence helpers, production context builder, production transcript replay helper, Vitest E2E/unit runners, TypeScript checks, and changed-file oxlint.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**

```text
pnpm --dir /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/issue-100368 exec node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.auto-reply-reply.config.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session-transcript-replay.test.ts
pnpm --dir /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/issue-100368 exec node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.e2e.config.ts src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner.runreplyagent.e2e.test.ts
pnpm --dir /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/issue-100368 tsgo:core:test
pnpm --dir /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/issue-100368 tsgo:core
pnpm --dir /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/issue-100368 exec node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner.ts src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner.runreplyagent.e2e.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session-transcript-replay.test.ts src/config/sessions/transcript-replay.ts src/config/sessions/undelivered-final-notice.ts
```

- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
verify-transcript-replay.log:
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  5 passed (5)

verify-agent-runner-e2e.log:
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  87 passed (87)

verify-tsgo-core-test.log:
$ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo

verify-tsgo-core.log:
$ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo

verify-oxlint.log:
[plugin-sdk boundary dts] fresh; skipping
[plugin-sdk package boundary root shims] fresh; skipping
```

- **Observed result after fix:** the E2E test creates a real session entry and transcript, runs the reply agent in `message_tool_only`, verifies `pendingFinalDelivery` remains unset, verifies the hidden custom undelivered notice is appended after the assistant final, and verifies `buildSessionContext()` includes that notice. The replay unit test verifies rotation replay copies that notice with the assistant turn and still skips unrelated custom records.
- **What was not tested:** retry recovery and unrelated dispatch behavior are outside this patch; the focused checks cover the changed transcript/context/replay boundary.
- **Fix classification:** Root cause fix for the session-state invariant: delivery reality must be represented before withheld assistant finals are consumed as replay/context.
- **Why it matters / User impact:** without the marker, the model-consumed context can contain a normal-looking assistant turn that the user never saw, which can cause the agent to assume acknowledgement or approval that did not happen.

## Review findings addressed

- **RF-001:** The issue's suggested narrow path was “Add replay-visible undelivered state.” This PR implements that path and does not choose the broader “replace withheld finals in replay” or “rely on recovery only” options.
- **RF-002:** The first runtime test only proved the marker was written; the regression now also proves the marker appears in `buildSessionContext()` and survives transcript rotation replay.

## Regression Test Plan

- **Target test file:** `src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner.runreplyagent.e2e.test.ts` and `src/auto-reply/reply/session-transcript-replay.test.ts`.
- **Scenario locked in:** a substantive final assistant reply is produced in `message_tool_only` mode without successful source reply delivery; the transcript receives a hidden `openclaw.message-tool-only-undelivered-final` notice, no pending final retry state is enabled, session context includes the notice, and transcript replay keeps that notice attached to the assistant turn.
- **Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail:** the E2E covers the runtime boundary that knows whether delivery actually happened, while the replay unit covers the separate rotation helper that could otherwise drop the marker. Mocking only the helper would miss the real session file/context path; a broader channel test would add unrelated delivery surface not changed here.

## Merge risk

This PR touches session-state and message-delivery metadata, with compatibility/security-boundary signals limited to a hidden custom transcript notice describing whether prior assistant text was user-visible.

## Risk / Compatibility

- **Risk labels considered:** compatibility, message-delivery, session-state, security-boundary.
- **Risk explanation:** the compatibility risk is that a new hidden custom transcript message can appear after a suppressed `message_tool_only` final; the message-delivery/session-state risk is that the notice changes model-consumed context for the affected lane; the security-boundary signal is limited to preventing private/undelivered assistant text from being mistaken for user-visible content.
- **Why acceptable:** the notice is gated by `sourceReplyDeliveryMode === "message_tool_only"`, not send-policy denied, no successful source reply delivery, non-empty final text, and non-silent final text. Delivered replies, silent replies, non-`message_tool_only` lanes, retry recovery, and unrelated custom records are unchanged. The focused E2E and replay tests cover the exact changed boundaries.

## What was not changed

- **What did NOT change:** retry recovery, heartbeat replay recovery, `pendingFinalDelivery`, source reply dispatch, message tool delivery, provider behavior, ordinary assistant transcript entries, public schema/defaults, and unrelated formatting/cleanup.
- Public API / schema / protocol / defaults: no public option, schema, protocol, or default value changed; the new constant is an internal transcript custom type used by session persistence/replay.
- Channel/provider/session/security behavior outside the fixed path: non-`message_tool_only` lanes, successful message tool delivery, send-policy denied paths, empty finals, and silent replies keep their existing behavior.
- Unrelated cleanup, docs, formatting, lockfiles: none.

## Root Cause

- **Root cause:** the `message_tool_only` delivery policy correctly suppresses ordinary source replies unless the message tool sends them, but the session transcript/context lifecycle did not persist that delivery-state invariant next to the withheld assistant final. Because the model-consumed context and replay tail only saw a normal assistant record, later runs could treat private undelivered text as if it had crossed the user-visible delivery boundary.
- **Why this is root-cause fix:** the runtime location changed here is the source-of-truth point that has all required state at once: source reply delivery mode, send-policy result, successful source delivery result, final assistant text, session key, session file, and workspace. Recording the notice there fixes the missing state before downstream context/replay consumes the transcript, and preserving the exact notice in replay prevents session rotation from losing the invariant again.
- **Maintainer-ready confidence:** High: the patch is narrow, the root state is recorded at the runtime boundary that owns delivery facts, the model-consumed context path is verified, and the replay preservation path is separately covered.
- **Patch quality notes:** The change avoids symptom masking by not changing retry recovery or delivery suppression. It adds one internal notice type, writes it only for substantive undelivered `message_tool_only` finals, and keeps replay permissive only for that exact notice while unrelated custom records remain skipped.
- **Architecture / source-of-truth check:** session state is the source-of-truth contract for what follow-up agents consume. This patch updates the persisted transcript before model-consumed context and replay projections read it; it is not a downstream display-only mirror or fallback.
